span.p:
Each request gets a 128-bit ULID:
48-bit timestamp + 80-bit random
Encoded as 26-char string — no database driver needed

span.div:
│ No coordination between data centers — IDs are globally unique │
│ Storage: 16 bytes per ID → 400 MB/s (34.6 TB/day) for 25M requests/sec│
